news.headline: Wall Street slides: S&P 500 -1.11%, Nasdaq -1.88%
news.what_happened: US equities closed sharply lower with tech leading; US 10Y yield remains elevated near 5.19%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off global tone and a >1% Nasdaq fall weigh on Indian IT and raise FII selling risk; defensives hold up better.

news.headline: Asia sell-off: Nikkei -4.63%, Hang Seng -1.02%
news.what_happened: Japan's Nikkei dropped about 4.6% and Hang Seng fell about 1% in early trade.
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asian risk-off sets a weak regional backdrop for the NSE open after Nifty's +1.16% prior session.

news.headline: Crude eases: WTI -1.17% to $93.98, Brent -1.55% to $104.42
news.what_happened: Oil slipped from elevated levels; dollar index also fell 0.5%.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude cuts fuel and raw-material costs for airlines and paints, though levels remain high.

news.headline: Gold jumps 1.3% to $4,161/oz
news.why_it_matters: Higher gold lifts collateral values for gold-loan NBFCs.

sector_outlook.reason: Risk-off vs. high US yields; no FII data

picks.logic: Jet fuel is ~35-40% of airline OPEX; further crude easing directly helps margins. Modest target given weak global tone.
Crude-linked inputs are 40-50% of raw material cost; lower crude is a direct margin tailwind.
Rising gold lifts collateral value and gold-loan demand; safe-haven bid in a risk-off session.
